title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on How to Calculate the Time Limit for Filing an Application for Labor Dispute Arbitration in Cases of Termination of Labor Contracts

articles.content_en:
July 26, 2004
Supreme People's Court
Reply on the Issue of How to Calculate the Time Limit for Applying for Labor Dispute
Arbitration Regarding Dissolution of Labor Contracts
Interpretation No. 8 [2004]
Higher People's Court of Yunnan Province:
Your Request for Instructions No. 256 [2004] (Yun Gao Fa [2004] No. 256) regarding how to calculate the time limit for parties to labor dispute cases to apply for labor dispute arbitration has been received. Upon review, we reply as follows:
If an employer dissolves a labor contract pursuant to the provisions of Article 25(4) of the Labor Law of the People's Republic of China and a dispute arises with a worker, the time limit for the worker to apply for arbitration with the labor dispute arbitration committee shall be calculated from the date on which the worker receives the written notice of dissolution of the labor contract.
This is our reply.
